notes: Machine-readable twin of ADR-002 (vault). Every entry is checked against the pinned spec by src/fork/__tests__/unit/arcane-spike.test.ts. tier: 1 = in the minimum read key, 2 = opt-in (exposes secrets, see exposure), never = must not be granted to the fork key, unused = write/POST, out of scope. proof: spike-results.json capability id or permission-matrix endpoint id; 'unverified' = not observed in the lab.

pagination.semantics: start is an item OFFSET (limit=2,start=2 -> currentPage 2); limit<=0 falls back to the server default (containers: 20; limit=10 requested on 10 items -> itemsPerPage 10); no upper bound enforced up to limit=1000; start beyond the end returns 200 with data [] and a clamped/odd currentPage
pagination.adapter_rule: request limit=100, loop start += limit until data.length < limit or start >= totalItems; never trust currentPage

capabilities.permission: environments:list (any authenticated key can read the list: every probed permission returned 200)
capabilities.notes: returns ALL environments incl. remote apiUrl (host names); adapter keeps only the allow-listed environment ids and never stores apiUrl of others
not needed: the list carries status + lastSeen

capabilities.permission: not granted to the read-only key (403)
capabilities.notes: POST; the read-only key gets 403 (probe). Remote-environment reachability is checked by a tier-1 list call with that environment id instead. Remote environments were not exercised (no Arcane agent started in the lab)
no compose bytes, no env values; list carries image refs + update info

capabilities.exposure: composeContent + overrideContent (raw YAML) AND services[].environment with RESOLVED env values (the .env contents) are returned
capabilities.notes: the only Arcane source of compose bytes; adapter must parse with an allow-list and drop services[].environment values (names only)
file tree of the Arcane project directory (names, sizes), incl. the env file and bind-mounted dirs inside it; fileTreeTruncated flag

capabilities.exposure: returns file BYTES of any non-compose file in the project directory, including the env file; compose files are refused (403 'project configuration is not part of the workspace'); '..' traversal is refused (403)
capabilities.notes: never called by the fork: .env contents are captured only by the agent-side files backup (05-Security-Model)

carries compose labels (project, service, working_dir, config_files), mounts (type, name, source, destination, rw; anonymous volumes have a hash name and source null), network memberships; NO env values (probed). Host-wide: lists every container on the Docker host, adapter filters by compose project

capabilities.exposure: config.env returns environment variable VALUES (secrets) in clear; /edit-config does the same
capabilities.notes: not needed for discovery (list has labels/mounts/networks)
volumes:read also unlocks the volume file browser

capabilities.exposure: volumes:read returns the BYTES of files inside any Docker volume of the environment (e.g. database files)
capabilities.notes: this is why volumes:read must never be granted to the fork key
membership is derived from containers.list networkSettings.networks
digests present in repoDigests; host-wide list (every local image)
currentVersion drives the compat check; also info.version in the spec

optional_deep.why: compose + override YAML; exposes resolved env values and project-dir file bytes
